mapper.sql: exchange_rates.id AS id, exchange_rates.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, (SELECT CONCAT(currency_centers.name, "(", currency_centers.symbol, ")") FROM currency_centers WHERE id = 1) AS currencyFrom, exchange_rates.currency_center_id AS currencyToId, CONCAT(currency_centers.name,"(", currency_centers.symbol, ")") AS currencyTo, exchange_rates.rate_to_sell AS rateForSell, exchange_rates.rate_to_change AS rateForChange, exchange_rates.rate_to_purchase AS rateForPurchase, DATE_FORMAT(exchange_rates.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(exchange_rates.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy

FROM exchange_rates LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = exchange_rates.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = exchange_rates.modified_by LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = exchange_rates.company_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = exchange_rates.currency_center_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exchange_rates( `company_id`, currency_center_id, rate_to_sell, rate_to_change, rate_to_purchase, created, created_by, is_active ) VALUES ( #{exchangeRate.companyId}, #{exchangeRate.currencyCenterId}, #{exchangeRate.rateForSell}, #{exchangeRate.rateForChange}, #{exchangeRate.rateForPurchase}, NOW(), #{exchangeRate.createdBy}, #{exchangeRate.isActive} );
mapper.update: UPDATE company_currencies SET `exchange_rate_id` = #{exchangeRate.exchangeRateId}, `rate_to_sell` = #{exchangeRate.rateForSell}, `rate_to_change` = #{exchangeRate.rateForChange}, `rate_to_purchase` = #{exchangeRate.rateForPurchase}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{exchangeRate.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{exchangeRate.id}
mapper.sql:
exchange_rates.id AS id, exchange_rates.company_id AS companyId, companies.name AS companyName, (SELECT CONCAT(currency_centers.name, "(", currency_centers.symbol, ")") FROM currency_centers WHERE id = 1) AS currencyFrom, 1.00 AS rate, exchange_rates.currency_center_id AS currencyToId, CONCAT(currency_centers.name,"(", currency_centers.symbol, ")") AS currencyTo,
exchange_rates.rate_to_sell AS rateForSell, exchange_rates.rate_to_change AS rateForChange, exchange_rates.rate_to_purchase AS rateForPurchase, DATE_FORMAT(exchange_rates.created, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS createdDate, DATE_FORMAT(exchange_rates.modified, '%d-%b-%y %h:%i') AS modifiedDate, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name ) AS createdBy, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name ) AS modifiedBy

FROM exchange_rates LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = exchange_rates.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = exchange_rates.modified_by LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = exchange_rates.company_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = exchange_rates.currency_center_id

WHERE exchange_rates.is_active = 1 AND exchange_rates.company_id = #{filter.companyId} AND exchange_rates.currency_center_id = #{filter.currencyId}
AND currency_centers.`name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
